warrantySupport.introBefore: This policy describes the general warranty terms applicable to the injection moulding machinery and robotics solutions of
warrantySupport.introAfter: , as well as the channels available for technical assistance and support. Specific conditions for each item of equipment take precedence over this general policy where set out in a contract or invoice.

cobertura.title: 1. Warranty Coverage
cobertura.p1: The Injectra warranty covers manufacturing defects in materials and components of injection moulding machinery (hydraulic and electric lines) and industrial robotics solutions, where the equipment is operated, installed and maintained in accordance with the technical specifications and manuals provided by Injectra.

prazo.title: 2. Warranty Period
prazo.p1: The standard warranty period is set out in the commercial proposal, sales contract and technical documentation accompanying each item of equipment, and may vary by machine line (PRIME, SPEED, VELOCITY, FORM, NEO, ATLAS, HYDRO, TITAN, MAX, EQUORA) and by component (for example, electronic, hydraulic and peripheral systems).
prazo.p2: The warranty period begins on the date of delivery or start-up of the equipment, as defined in the contract.

exclusoes.title: 3. Warranty Exclusions
list: Natural wear and tear of consumable parts, such as seals, filters and friction components
Damage caused by improper operation, installation that does not comply with technical specifications, or use beyond the equipment's rated capacity
Technical work carried out by third parties not authorised by Injectra
Use of parts or supplies that are not original or approved by Injectra
Damage arising from inadequate electrical, hydraulic or infrastructure installation by the customer
Force majeure events, such as power outages, natural disasters or accidents

comoSolicitar.title: 4. How to Request Warranty Service
comoSolicitar.p1: To request warranty service, the customer should contact Injectra or the authorised representative responsible for their region, providing the equipment's serial number, the purchase invoice and a description of the issue. Our technical team will assess the case and determine the appropriate course of action, which may include remote support, a technical visit or the dispatch of parts.

pecas.title: 5. Replacement Parts and Technical Assistance
pecas.p1Before: Injectra and its representative network provide original replacement parts and specialist technical assistance for the entire machinery and robotics range, even after the warranty period has ended. Please consult our

canais.title: 6. Technical Support Channels
canais.p1Before: In addition to this policy, we maintain a dedicated support centre offering technical assistance, parts requests, preventive and corrective maintenance, and FAQs. Visit our
canais.p1After: page to open a ticket or speak to our technical team.

contratos.title: 7. Maintenance Contracts and Extended Warranty
contratos.p1: Injectra offers preventive maintenance contracts and extended warranty programmes for customers wishing to extend standard cover or formalise periodic maintenance routines. Commercial terms for these contracts are negotiated individually with our team or an authorised representative.

alteracoes.title: 8. Changes to this Policy
alteracoes.p1: Injectra may update this warranty and support policy periodically. Changes take effect upon publication on this page, without affecting warranty terms already formalised in existing contracts and invoices.

oQueSao.title: 1. What Are Cookies
oQueSao.p1: Cookies are small text files stored on your browser or device when you visit a website. They allow the website to recognise your device, remember preferences and collect information about how the website is used.

comoUsamos.title: 2. How We Use Cookies
list: Ensure the website and the quote request form function correctly
Remember browsing preferences, such as language and region
Understand how visitors use our website, and which catalogues and machine lines generate the most interest
Measure the effectiveness of marketing and communication campaigns

essenciais.title: 3.1 Essential Cookies
essenciais.p: Necessary for the basic functioning of the website, such as navigating between pages and submitting forms. These cannot be disabled in our systems.

desempenho.title: 3.2 Performance and Analytics Cookies
desempenho.p: Collect information on how visitors use the website — most visited pages, browsing time and traffic source — to help us improve content and usability.

funcionalidade.title: 3.3 Functionality Cookies
funcionalidade.p: Allow us to remember choices made by the user, such as language, region or pre-filled form details, for a more personalised experience.

marketing.title: 3.4 Marketing Cookies
marketing.p: Used to display more relevant communications and adverts based on your interest in our machine lines, robotics and the Injectra AI platform, both on and off our website.

terceiros.title: 4. Third-Party Cookies
terceiros.p1: Some cookies are set by third-party services that appear on our pages, such as traffic analysis tools, maps and embedded videos. Injectra does not control these cookies, which are subject to the privacy policies of their respective providers.

gerenciar.title: 5. How to Manage Your Cookie Preferences
gerenciar.p1: You can manage or disable cookies directly through your browser settings, by blocking new cookies or removing those already stored. Please note that disabling essential cookies may affect the correct functioning of the website, including the submission of quote and contact forms.

alteracoes.title: 6. Updates to this Policy
alteracoes.p1: This Cookie Policy may be updated periodically to reflect changes in our practices or in the technologies used. The date of the last update appears at the top of this page.

compromisso.title: 1. Our Commitment to Ethics and Integrity
compromisso.p1: Injectra is committed to conducting its business with honesty, respect for applicable law, and responsibility towards customers, employees, representatives, suppliers and the communities in which it operates, supporting the sustainable growth of industry across the Americas.

codigoConduta.title: 2. Code of Conduct
codigoConduta.p1: Injectra's employees, directors and representatives must uphold principles of integrity, mutual respect, non-discrimination and workplace safety, avoid conflicts of interest, and always act in accordance with applicable law and the company's internal policies.

anticorrupcao.title: 3. Anti-Corruption and Fraud Prevention
anticorrupcao.p1: Injectra does not tolerate any form of corruption, bribery or improper payment in its business dealings, whether with public officials or private parties. As an American company, we observe the principles of the Foreign Corrupt Practices Act (FCPA) and other applicable anti-corruption legislation in the countries in which we operate, including Brazil.
anticorrupcao.p2: Authorised representatives and commercial partners are also subject to these guidelines in their dealings on Injectra's behalf.

fornecedores.title: 5. Relationships with Suppliers and Partners
fornecedores.p1: We expect Injectra's suppliers, representatives and commercial partners to uphold standards of ethics, legality and respect for human and labour rights equivalent to our own, including the rejection of child labour, forced labour and anti-competitive practices.

concorrencia.title: 6. Fair Competition
concorrencia.p1: Injectra competes in the market on the basis of the quality of its products and services, complying with applicable competition law and avoiding agreements or practices that improperly restrict free competition.

canalDenuncias.title: 7. Whistleblowing Channel
canalDenuncias.p1: Employees, customers, representatives and suppliers may confidentially report suspected breaches of this compliance commitment, including unethical conduct, acts of corruption or non-compliance with applicable law, through the channel indicated in the contact section below.
